content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the FDDI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of FDDI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the FDDI recruitment is 16 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/ B.Tech / B.Sc in Civil Engineering with a minimum of 50% marks. A Master's degree in Civil Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the FDDI recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 55 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for FDDI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Superintending Engineer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Superintending Engineer post is Rs. 120000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: According to the extracted data, there are 0 vacancies for the Chief Engineer post. However, there is 1 vacancy for the Superintending Engineer post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for FDDI jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official FDDI website.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The link to download the official notification PDF is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis by the Footwear Design & Development Institute.
